category_title: Quietly on-task students who struggle with independent inquiry and rely on peer cues
scenario_title: Independent work during science inquiry tasks
minimal_context: The student is completing an independent worksheet during the ecology unit.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please complete the independent work for our ecology unit. Read the text and answer the questions on your worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Nods and looks down at the worksheet, quietly taking notes on the inquiry activity.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Are you making progress on the questions?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues to work independently with minimal interaction, opening a new tab on the Internet to search for the answer rather than raising a hand.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep trying to find the answers on your own.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Glances over at the student sitting next to him) When I need help, I would just guess or see if I would try and figure it out. Mostly I looked for what other people were doing. That’s how I completed my work.

TUTOR: Please complete the independent work for our ecology unit. Read the text and answer the questions on your worksheet.

TUTOR: Keep trying to find the answers on your own.

STUDENT: (Glances over at the student sitting next to him) When I need help, I would just guess or see if I would try and figure it out. Mostly I looked for what other people were doing. That’s how I completed my work.

task.content: Completing independent work during the 9-week ecology unit

context.materials: Internet, videos, graphs, scientific inquiry labs
context.social_setting: Independent work phase and small groups

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When needing help, getting 'stuck', or working independently
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Reported guessing answers, using the Internet for assistance, or looking for what other people were doing rather than raising their hand
related_quotes: Mostly I looked for what other people were doing. That’s how I completed my work.
When I need help, I would just guess or see if I would try and figure it out.

behavior_patterns.condition: During general classroom engagement in inquiry activities and whole-class instruction
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Quietly on-task (e.g., taking notes, displaying teacher check-in signal) but interactions were more minimal and often worked independently even in group settings
